verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice can store customer cards to auto-charge recurring transactions and offers a customer portal. However, nothing in the pack documents a network account updater, backup or fallback payment methods, or a hosted page where customers update an expiring or replaced card. Card storage and the portal are adjacent features, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, expiring or replaced cards update themselves — network account updater, backup payment methods, and hosted update-payment pages
